thread:
Maria R: Drafting deprecation playbook for v1 -> v2 and the planned model swap. Pushed a sandbox PR (github.com/redwood/docs/pull/924) with a migration checklist and updated snippets. Can folks skim for glaring inaccuracies?

Dave L: On it. Quick Q — are we explicitly renaming `models.generate()` -> `client.responses.create()` in the migration guide? I think that was the main break.

Maria R: Yes — calling out the API surface rename + payload format change. I added a short side-by-side snippet showing old vs new. It's in the "API changes" section.

Ali K: I can check the SDK snippets. Will verify TypeScript and Python examples. Any behavioral changes for streaming?

Maria R: Streaming stays but framing changed (stream event names). I added a note: update consumers that parse event types.

Kevin S: Heads up — Dedicated customers on pinned model versions will still get the old model alias until their infra is rolled. We should add a note for dedicated/private about rollout timing and fallback.

Maria R: Good call, Kevin — added a small section about Dedicated/Private rollout windows and recommended customer comms.

Anya P: For the docs redirects: do we want to keep old anchors and add meta-refresh, or fully remove pages? Ops prefers redirects for 30 days.

Maria R: Ops' approach sounds safest. I'll add a short redirect plan and a small task list for the web team.

docs-bot: Deploy preview for PR 924 is ready: https://deploy.preview.redwood.dev/924 (expires in 7 days) :white_check_mark:

Dave L: Quick snippet nit: your new TypeScript sample still does `client.models.predict({ model: "rwd-v1" })` in one place. That should be `client.responses.create({ model: "rwd-v2" })`. I'll push a tiny commit to the branch.

Maria R: Thanks — saw your commit. Can someone validate the Python example? I updated it but didn't run it against the dev runtime.

Ali K: Running Python now. Found a doc mismatch for embedding calls — old `embed()` vs new `client.embeddings.create()`. Will send a patch.

Kevin S: Also add a short troubleshooting FAQ about 401s after the SDK update — some customers hit stricter token scopes.

Maria R: Added an FAQ item for token scopes and a sample curl that shows the new header format.

Dave L: Suggest adding a tiny migration checklist at the top: (1) update SDK versions, (2) replace API calls, (3) verify streaming handlers, (4) test model aliasing and fallback. That helps engs skim.

Maria R: Done. Also added a short rollback suggestion: pin old client and set routing fallback to `compat-model` in the short term.

Anya P: For release comms — can we flag the docs PR as a "breaking change" in the changelog and draft a short email for existing Dedicated customers? I'll prepare the email and share a copy in the thread.

Maria R: Great — once Ali/Dave/kevin confirm the snippets, I'll merge and coordinate publish windows with Anya.

Ali K: Python snippet validated against staging runtime. I fixed the embeddings example and added a 1-line note about `max_tokens` being interpreted differently.

Dave L: TS snippet validated. Streaming example includes the new event names. I left an inline comment about adding a migration test in `docs/snippets/tests`.

Kevin S: I've updated the Dedicated rollout note to include a 48-hour notice period and contact template.

Maria R: Excellent. Plan: merge after 24h review. If no objections, publish on Wednesday, add redirects, and trigger the customer email for Dedicated. Thanks everyone :tada:

Anya P: Marking this thread for follow-up. I'll post the Dedicated customer email draft shortly. :memo:

Dave L: LGTM from docs side.

Ali K: LGTM.

Kevin S: LGTM.

Maria R: Merging in ~24h unless we get new blockers.
